purpose: Offline Ghidra derivation of the App Library category-miniature flat-image dispatch redirect; no writer included

os.identitySource: local exact shared-cache image; device not queried

encoding.kind: preopt_cache_entry_t packed 26-bit selector offset plus signed 38-bit class-relative IMP

target.implementation: load the manager's stored byte at +0x1e5; return

ghidraBehavioralRoute.managerConfiguration: -[SBHIconManager configureIconView:forIcon:] reads prefersFlatImageLayers and sends setPrefersFlatImageLayers: to the SBIconView
ghidraBehavioralRoute.customControllerPropagation: -[SBIconView configureCustomIconImageViewController:] copies prefersFlatImageLayers into a supporting custom image-view controller
ghidraBehavioralRoute.libraryControllerPropagation: -[SBHLibraryIconViewController setPrefersFlatImageLayers:] forwards the value to SBHLibraryCategoryStackView
ghidraBehavioralRoute.miniatureDecision: -[SBHLibraryCategoryStackView _innerIconImageOptions] returns 0x11 when prefersFlatImageLayers is true and 0x1 otherwise
ghidraBehavioralRoute.rebuildBoundary: -[SBHLibraryCategoryStackView setPrefersFlatImageLayers:] invokes _updateIconImageViewsAnimated: when the value changes

claim.implemented: bounded exact-entry dispatch redirect selecting the stock flat-image policy for future SpringBoard App Library category miniature construction
claim.notYetProved: rendered transparency of the four 27-point miniature app plates on the physical device
